# GenomeAdmixR

## Role

`GenomeAdmixR` is an R package for forward-time, individual-based simulation of
admixture and ancestry along genomes. It is a candidate backend for synthetic
ancestry-tract benchmarks, not an inference tool for real local ancestry.

## Appropriate simitall Use

- Simulate an admixed cohort with known source labels, generations since
  admixture, mating model, recombination map, and ancestry tracts.
- Retain the simulated local-ancestry truth for benchmarking downstream
  inference or association methods.
- Generate scenario grids that vary reference-panel mismatch, admixture time,
  source divergence, or phenotype-effect architecture.

## Do Not Use It For

- Calling local ancestry in a real cohort.
- Replacing a real reference panel when the question is empirical.
- Claiming that arbitrary source populations reproduce human demographic
  history without calibration and validation.

## References

- CRAN package page: https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=GenomeAdmixR
- Janzen et al. (2021): DOI 10.1111/2041-210X.13612.
